title: bench-result.json written by a Backtrace benchmark app after one launch/run

sdkVersion.description: Published version (3.14.0), 'local-SNAPSHOT', or git sha for HEAD

scenario.description: default | largeapk | diag | seeded-<N> | busy | idle

appId.description: applicationId / bundle id / Unity product name actually launched

platform.description: android | ios | macos | tvos | unity-editor | unity-android | unity-ios

stages.description: Ordered SDK init stages timed with a monotonic clock on the thread that called the SDK

name.description: client | native | metrics | anr | breadcrumbs | repository | pendingCrash | crashReporter | watcher | oom | refresh | database | ...

ok.description: false when the stage threw or returned failure; row is then invalid

totalMs.description: Wall time from first SDK call to last stage end on the calling thread

counters.description: Deterministic counts sampled after init (thread count, timers, bytes written, mock requests received...)

samples.description: Optional in-process micro results keyed by metric id, each an array of per-iteration values in the metric unit
